minted.name: contentstack-codeline-investigator
minted.rationale: This codeline is the sole repository in scope and an investigator is needed to map its Contentstack integration, context-based content pipeline, and test conventions before implementers touch it.

minted.name: contentstack-sdk-engineer
minted.rationale: The Stack initialization in contentstack.ts needs live_preview configuration added and @contentstack/live-preview-utils declared as a dependency, which requires focused SDK-level work distinct from the React context wiring.

minted.name: contentstack-preview-react-engineer
minted.rationale: The onEntryChange callback must be wired into the React context that distributes Contentstack content, not individual page components, which requires React-specific integration work separate from SDK configuration.
